brief:
Palestinian resistance factions said elections represent a critical opportunity to resolve the internal political split and reorganize Palestinian governance on a foundation of power-sharing, Shehab Wire reported. The factions underscored their commitment to preserving national unity and strengthening political partnership among rival groups that have remained divided for years.

The resistance movements called for establishing suitable conditions to conduct elections that would accurately reflect popular will while protecting Palestinian national constants and rights. They argued that such a political process, properly managed, could help consolidate the fractured Palestinian political structure and restore coherence to decision-making across competing factions.
